news.title: Blizzard Refunding Gold for Players Who Purchased Skills During Monday Server Issues
news.description: Blizzard is refunding gold to players who purchased skills during the server issues on Monday.
news.details:
Earlier this week, Blizzard was forced to take down the servers due to issues. During this time, players lost some purchases during this time including some skills and Shaman Totems. They seem to be working on resolving the issues.
With in-game mail that has now gone out to all affected players, we have refunded the cost of skill purchases that were made on Monday, November 9 between 1:17 p.m. PST and 2:17 p.m. PST (8:17-9:17 a.m. on November 10 AEDT) when the WoW: Forever servers experienced issues that caused some players to lose training they purchased.
If you were affected by this issue during that timeframe, check your in-game mail for gold equaling the cost of training that you purchased and lost.
Thank you very much for your patience and understanding.

news.title: Riverglades is One of the Best Leveling Zones in WoW: Forever
news.description: Many players have mentioned that the Riverglades is one of the best leveling zones in WoW: Forever, so make sure to visit on your journey to 60!
news.details:
Riverglades Zone Guide
The Riverglades is a brand new zone in WoW: Forever and has been designed to feel like it always belonged in Classic WoW. Many players have mentioned that the Riverglades is their favorite leveling zone on their journey to level 60, so make sure to check it out yourself!
Riverglades Information
The Riverglades is a new zone on the east edge of the Eastern Kingdoms and it neighbors the Badlands and Redridge Mountains. This zone is designed for players around 38 to 44, though players recommend going there around level 40 in order to be the appropriate level for some quests. The main method to enter the zone is through the ship in Tanaris, east of Gadgetzhan.
This will drop you off at Powderfuse Port, the neutral town. There is also a faction-specific town, Farholde Keep for the Alliance and Rog'mar for the Horde.

news.title: Skyborne Don't Have Reputation Discount for Mounts in WoW: Forever
news.description: Skyborne don't get the 10% reputation discount for learning your mount in WoW: Forever!
news.details:
WoW: Forever Mount Guide
Learning your mount is a big deal in WoW: Forever, as it significantly cuts down travel time. However, there's both a level requirement and a hefty Gold cost to learn your Riding Skill.
Riding SkillLevel RequiredMount SpeedTraining CostMount Cost
Apprentice Riding4060% (first is free)
Journeyman Riding60100%
You can learn Riding Skill at your racial Riding Trainer. Other races' Riding Trainers will not offer you training until you hit Exalted reputation with them. Your racial Riding Trainer also offers you a 10% discount when you hit Honored with them, which can save you a lot of Gold. However, there's a problem with this for Skyborne, the new race in WoW: Forever.

news.title: Blizzard Taking Down WoW: Forever Realms in 30 Minutes to Fix Urgent Server Crash
news.description: Blizzard has announced emergency realm maintenance in 30 minutes to fix an urgent server crash for WoW: Forever realms.
news.details:
Announced in-game through a message and listed on the Battle.net launcher, Blizzard will be taking down the WoW: Forever servers for realm restarts.
Hey folks, we've discovered an urgent server crash that we need to fix with restarts. All realms will come down in 30 minutes and be back quickly afterwards. Sorry for interrupting your Friday!
We will be performing maintenance beginning on Friday, November 13th, 11:00 AM (PST) and we expect the service to be available again at approximately 12:00 PM (PST). During this time the game will be unavailable for play.
It's rare for Blizzard to take down servers with little notice, so this must be really urgent. Hopefully you aren't in any long dungeons; otherwise, you might not be able to finish.

news.title: New Short Story “Cost of Honor” for WoW: Forever
news.description: Blizzard has released a new short story for WoW: Forever called "The Cost of Honor"!
news.details:
As a storm rages in the skies above, the young people of the Riverglades gather around a campfire to hear the stories behind their history’s legends from the great Demar Brant. Through tales of war, sacrifice, and hard choices, they learn that the true strength of a people lies not in victory alone, but in the courage to protect one another.
Join Demar Brant for a special fireside telling of our newest short story, “Cost of Honor”.
Written By : Jonathan Maberry
Illustrated By : Surfside 3D
Narrated By : Peter Jessop as Demar Brant

news.title: Might of Stormwind World Buff Returns in WoW: Forever
news.description: First introduced in Season of Discovery, the Might of Stormwind World Buff has returned for Alliance players in WoW: Forever.
news.details: The Might of Stormwind buff was introduced in SoD to be a direct 1:1 to the Horde's Warchief's Blessing buff, since prior to Season of Discovery, the Horde only had access to this Haste and Health world buff. Similar to the Horde getting their buff, Alliance players must complete End of the Dark Horde by looting the Head of Rend Blackhand off of Warchief Rend Blackhand in Upper Blackrock Spire. As a reminder, world buffs are only accessible in the open world and dungeons, and not in raid instances in WoW: Forever

news.title: Secret Disguise Toy Found WoW: Forever
news.description: A new secret toy, the Alcaz Operative Disguise, has been found in WoW Forever, starting in the new dungeon: Alcaz Prison.
news.details:
A new secret toy, the Alcaz Operative Insignia, has been found in WoW Forever, starting in the new dungeon: Alcaz Prison. All the information for this secret has once again come from The WoW Secret Finding Discord!
How to Acquire the Alcaz Operative Disguise Toy
Players can start this chain by entering and clearing out the dungeon of Alcaz prison. When doing so, DO NOT kill the first boss: The Questioner, as you will need him for the quest you pick up at the end of the dungeon: The Man in the Iron Chains.
Players will then travel to Moonbrook in Westfall and then either Stormwind for Alliance or Booty Bay for Horde to be awarded the Fractured Insignia. Combining six of these will award the player the Alcaz Operative Insignia,
